{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Producers Midstream Gas Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/CP25-531-000.pdf|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/news-events/news/summaries-march-2026-commission-meeting|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Childress County, Texas to Washita County, Oklahoma.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/CP25-531-000.pdf|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-00407|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==

=== Palo Duro Lease Agreement Project ===
*'''Owner: '''Palo Duro Transmission LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/CP25-531-000.pdf|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''80,000 Dth/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/CP25-531-000.pdf|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://eastdaley.com/the-burner-tip/company-plans-project-to-convert-permian-line-to-interstate-service|title=eastdaley.com|website=eastdaley.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''16 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/CP25-531-000.pdf|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Proposed<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/CP25-531-000.pdf|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/news-events/news/summaries-march-2026-commission-meeting|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2025<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://producersmidstream.com/palo-duro-pipeline-project-notice-of-binding-open-season/|title=producersmidstream.com|website=producersmidstream.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/55300432/producers-midstream-launches-open-season-for-service-on-palo-duro-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-15873|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
